description.it: Le copie acquisite tra le due date, in ordine di numero d'inventario, con la provenienza e il valore: quello che la segreteria registra nell'inventario.
description.en: The copies acquired between the two dates, in the order of their inventory numbers, with origin and value: what the school office records in the inventory.

sql: SELECT i.inventory_number AS inventory_number, i.barcode AS barcode, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, b.publisher AS publisher, b.publication_year AS year, COALESCE(i.acquisition_date, date(i.created_at)) AS acquired_on, i.origin AS origin, i.value_cents / 100.0 AS value FROM item i JOIN biblio b ON b.id = i.biblio_id WHERE COALESCE(i.acquisition_date, date(i.created_at)) BETWEEN :from AND :to ORDER BY i.inventory_number IS NULL, length(i.inventory_number), i.inventory_number, acquired_on, i.barcode
